corridor-canvas-oversize.jpg.title: Corridor Canvases — Oversize
corridor-canvas-oversize.jpg.blurb: Three oversize canvases down a working corridor. At this scale the wrap depth is what stops them reading as posters.

canvas-wrap-edge-vineyard.jpg.title: Wrapped Edge — Corner Detail
canvas-wrap-edge-vineyard.jpg.blurb: Corners folded by hand and the image carried around the return, so there is nothing raw to see from the side.

canvas-wrap-quartet.jpg.title: Canvas Quartet — Warm Neutrals
canvas-wrap-quartet.jpg.blurb: Four gallery-wrapped canvases hung tight, so the set reads as one field of colour rather than four pictures.

canvas-wrap-edge-detail.jpg.title: Wrapped Edge — Profile Study
canvas-wrap-edge-detail.jpg.blurb: The side view: image carried around a deep bar, no staples in sight from the front.

statement-canvas-bedroom.jpg.title: Statement Canvas — Bedroom
statement-canvas-bedroom.jpg.blurb: One oversized canvas centred over the bed. At this scale a single piece does more than a cluster ever could.
